page.overview:
Who is Ake?

Doctor Ake was a Rattataki female who served the reconstituted Sith Empire. She was present in the Imperial Command Center on Ossus during the Empire's invasion of the planet.

Doctor Ake serves as an Imperial stim vendor on Ossus in the massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne.
